title: Stop presenting a fabricated transaction count on the homepage
prompt:
Remove the fabricated live transaction statistic; work on the assigned branch you are on. Edit only apps/web/src/app/page.tsx as production code. apps/web/src/app/page.tsx:189-197 fetches the API discovery document and unconditionally set agents: 1 and transactions: 3 after JSON parsing. Line 233 then renders that value as "3 txns" in the live badge. The discovery response at apps/web/src/app/api/v1/route.ts:4-36 contains metadata, not transaction counts. Executing the existing effect body with a metadata-only response locally confirmed it assigns those hardcoded statistics.

Remove the liveStats state, its metadata fetch effect, and the transaction-count fragment. Keep the badge's API location text and the interactive demo intact. This is a small truthfulness correction, not a request to build analytics or fetch private ledger data. Remove any import made unused by deleting that effect. Do not alter other feature claims or the simulated registration and funding behavior.

Add tests/ui/homepage-statistics.test.mjs as a dependency-free node:test source-contract regression, consistent with this repository's existing source-contract tests. Assert that Home no longer sets or renders fabricated transaction statistics, no longer fetches discovery to infer counts, and retains the API location badge and TerminalDemo. Run node --test tests/ui/homepage-statistics.test.mjs and node --test tests/security/*.test.mjs. No credentials, external sends, payments, deployments, migrations, auth, workflows or package.json changes. Do not commit or push.
